attempts.notes: Doubled from four turns to eight and cost a Pokemon. Delcatty's Fake Out flinched a Mega Metagross on turn 1 and denied the opening KO; Stantler's Thunder Wave paralysed Incineroar, which then missed two turns to full paralysis and was worn down by Lickitung and Munchlax Body Slams. protect_ledger.payoff: real - at 23/146 it blocked a Mega Metagross Bullet Punch that was lethal, surviving a full extra turn
real - at 24/193 it blocked a lethal Bullet Punch and lived to act again

ai_observations: Both Protects were used at exactly the HP where they were worth a turn, and the Fake Out was aimed at the mega-evolving threat rather than the safer target. This is the best AI play in the block.
could_this_be_cooler: Munchlax's Recycle never fires because Body Slam is always at least as attractive and the berry never gets consumed under pressure; the snack-recycling idea would need Gluttony to actually trigger (lower HP, or a pinch berry that the AI values). Worth revisiting, but the team plays well as-is. Not changed in this pass.
